html: A stroke is an emergency. Call 911 right away and note the time symptoms started. Some treatments only work if given within hours.

• Balance: sudden loss of balance or coordination
  • Eyes: sudden vision loss or double vision
  • Face: one side of the face droops
  • Arms: one arm drifts down or is weak
  • Speech: slurred or strange speech
  • Time: call 911 now

• Keep blood pressure under control
  • Do not smoke
  • Manage diabetes and cholesterol
  • Stay physically active

title: Stroke warning signs
abstract: Use BE FAST to spot the signs of a stroke and get help quickly.
